data.name: Rahime
data.gender_notes: Rahime is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Rahman, one of the names of Allah, signifying compassion and mercy. The name Rahime carries the meaning “Compassionate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rahime usually hope their child will grow to embody compassionate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name reminding the child to be merciful and compassionate.
data.etymology: Rahime belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Compassionate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rahime total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: رحيمة
in_arabic.meaning: رحيمة تعني الرحمة و العطف و اللطف
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم رحيمة مشتق من الرحمة، و هي من صفات الله تعالى، و تعني المرأة التي تتصف بالرحمة و العطف و اللطف، و هي من الأسماء المحببة في الإسلام لأنها تعكس صفة من صفات الله الجميلة

in_urdu.name: رحیمہ
in_urdu.meaning: رحیمہ کا مطلب رحمت اور مہربانی ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: رحیمہ نام عربی زبان کی رحمة سے ماخوذ ہے، جو اللہ تعالی کی صفت ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو رحمت اور مہربانی کی خصوصیت رکھتی ہے، یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ اللہ کی خوبصورت صفات میں سے ایک کو ظاہر کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: रहीमा
in_hindi.meaning: रहीमा का अर्थ है दया और करुणा
in_hindi.long_meaning: रहीमा नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है दया और करुणा, यह नाम अल्लाह की विशेषताओं में से एक है, और यह महिला के लिए एक सुंदर नाम है जो दया और प्रेम की भावना को दर्शाता है, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है

in_pashto.name: رحیمه
in_pashto.meaning: رحیمه د رحمت او مړوندۍ معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: رحیمه نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د رحمت او مړوندۍ ده، دا نوم د الله تعالی یو له صفاتو څخه دی، او داسې ښځې ته ورکول کیږي چې د رحمت او مړوندۍ ځانګړتیا ولري، دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو په دودیزو نومونو کې ډیر اهمیت لري

in_english.name: Rahime
in_english.meaning: Rahime means merciful, compassionate, and kind
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rahime originates from the Arabic root 'R-H-M', which signifies mercy and compassion, it is one of the attributes of Allah in Islam, symbolizing a person who embodies kindness, empathy, and love, this name holds significant spiritual and cultural value in Islamic tradition, reflecting a desirable personality trait of being gentle and caring towards others

Rahman is the name of Allah that signifies compassion, mercy, and kindness towards His creation. The name Rahime is often used in Islamic communities to evoke the feelings of compassion, kindness, and mercy. It’s a name that resonates with the deep rooted cultural and spiritual values of Islam.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Rahime lies in its connection to Allah, the Almighty. As the name is derived from Rahman, one of the names of Allah, it signifies the presence and blessings of Allah in a person's life. It’s a reminder of Allah's mercy and kindness towards His creation. The name Rahime is not just an identity, but a manifestation of Allah's mercy and compassion. It's a name that inspires one to be compassionate and kind towards others.
